text: pañcālacaṇḍasuttaṃ [236] ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho pañcālacaṇḍo devaputto bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi sambādhe vata okāsaṃ avindi bhūrimedhaso yo jhānamabuddhi buddho 1 paṭilīnanisabho munīti . [237] sambādhepi ca tiṭṭhanti 2 [pañcālacaṇḍāti bhagavā] dhammaṃ nibbānapattiyā ye satiṃ paccalatthaṃsu sammā te susamāhitāti . aṭṭhamaṃ
